Name: Joja Cam Project
Author: adverserath
Description:
Lets you watch the world through another character's eyes. Pick an NPC, another player, or an animal and your camera follows them around their location. Press any button to snap back to yourself.

[b]May cause issues with cut-scenes. [/b]The game wasn't designed to work this way, and as such can have side effects.

[size=4]Features[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Spy on anyone.[/b] Follow a villager, another online player, or a pet / horse / farm animal wherever they are.[/*]
[*][b]Searchable picker.[/b] Choose a category, then type to filter by name. Each result shows the character's current location.[/*]
[*][b]Smooth camera.[/b] The viewport eases toward the target so it glides instead of teleporting — handy for remote players whose position updates in coarse network steps.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer-safe.[/b] Only the [i]rendered[/i] location follows the target; your farmer stays pinned where you left them, so other players never see your avatar wander into their house.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Joja-Cam
Manifest.Description: Press a button to pick any NPC or player and watch through their location. Press again to return.
